registry_correction: Registry 'progressive, individual, IRPP + CAC multiplier' confirmed and extended: IRPP 10/15/25/35 % on (gross - 30 % frais capped at 4.8 M - CNPS pension) - 500 000 (arts. 29, 34, 69); CAC 10 % of the tax (art. 71); plus wage levies outside the IRPP: TDL (communal, flat by monthly base salary), CFC 1 %, RAV (monthly flat by gross); CNPS pension 4.2 % capped at 750 000 a month. No family quotient.
